name: loopseed
description: Minimal evidence-driven loops plus an explicit One-Shotted autonomous completion mode.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence loops and one-instruction autonomous completion.
interface.longDescription: Use the ordinary minimal loop for scoped work, or explicitly invoke One-Shotted mode to turn one human authorization into a contract-bound implementation, independent verification, repair, and finalization run.
defaultPrompt: $loopseed Complete this goal through the smallest evidence-driven loop; continue until verified or truly blocked.
